pages.text: The Organa biome is about growth. It has Organa blocks and Organa end stone, Organa weed (it gives seeds), Organa plants (they give fruit), Organa fluid lakes and spores.$(br2)Wild Organa flowers are dormant. They add no entropy.
Organa fruit: eat it to fly for a short time (flight 1). You also teleport.$(br2)Organa fluid makes you levitate. Be careful.
